name: GA-ready-fades
new:
if (s.phase === 'gone') return s;
  if (s.phase === 'ready') return now - s.since >= 2000 ? { ...s, phase: 'gone', since: now } : s;
note: GFX-ALWAYS: ready fades off the menu again

name: GA-shown-before-a-count
old:
if (!settled && total === 0) return s; // nothing started yet
    if (settled && (full || total === 0)) return { ...s, phase: 'ready', done, total, fullAt: now, since: now };
new: if (settled && (full || total === 0)) return { ...s, phase: 'ready', done, total, fullAt: now, since: now };
note: GFX-ALWAYS: an empty bar before anything has started
